correctness.rationale: Exact 4095-mask four-chart Gröbner scan independently gives 1116 smooth forms and the 12-cell joint table. A second calculation partitions 4095 forms into 165 PGL2(F2)^2 orbits, with 39 smooth orbits, matching the same weights; degree-two separability and the Deuring–Shafarevich branch formula identify p-rank as #distinct roots of B minus one, and direct F4 zeta computations agree on all 39 representatives. Genus two follows from adjunction. All ranges and relevant characteristic-two boundary conditions were checked.

value.rationale: The (2,3) linear system is a natural family of genus-two curves on a split quadric, with a distinguished hyperelliptic projection. Comparing the arithmetic point count to the 2-rank stratification tests how moduli strata distribute in an enumerative family; the exact weighted distribution distinguishes all 12 possible nonempty arithmetic regimes. It is neither a mere change of notation nor an arbitrary slice of equation coefficients; only numerical frequencies, not all abstract genus-two classifications, are claimed new.
